item.title: Rust 1.91.1: Critical Wasm and illumos Fixes and Why You Should Upgrade
item.description: A plain‑English explanation of the two regressions fixed in Rust 1.91.1 around WebAssembly imports and Cargo target directory locking on illumos, what risks they introduced, and why even beginners should move off 1.91.0.

item.title: Is the Electron Era Ending? Rust GPUI Lets You Stop Compromising on Cross‑Platform
item.description: Electron made desktop cross‑platform easy; Rust GPUI makes it feel native fast. This beginner‑friendly briefing explains the core idea, the minimal runnable path, and a humane migration plan.
